# Screen Color Picker

> Free in-browser color picker: sample any pixel on your screen (even outside the browser) and copy it as HEX, RGB, HSL or OKLCH. No install, no account.

## What it does
Uses the browser-native EyeDropper API (desktop Chrome/Edge/Brave/Opera 95+) to sample any on-screen pixel. A screenshot mode (getDisplayMedia + 10x magnifier) works in Firefox and Safari too. Keeps a local palette of recent colors.

## Privacy
Picked colors and screenshot frames are processed locally and never uploaded. Palette history is stored in localStorage. The site uses Google Analytics 4 and AdSense behind a consent banner (see /privacy-policy/).

## Limits
Live picking is Chromium desktop only; no mobile browser supports EyeDropper. The live picker cancels on focus loss. Screenshot mode needs a screen-share prompt each time.
